releaseNotes:
# Changelog 0.1.33

## Changes since v0.1.0

- Open the view that defines an inspected element and go back to the previous one (#33) (`57b5901`)
- Show element XAML in an in-app viewer and make the external editor configurable (#32) (`2029e18`)
- Remove unused preset and clear-selection commands (#29) (`40d0a2d`)
- Make the inspector an opt-in, one-shot selection mode like Chrome DevTools (#28) (`badc5a6`)
- Show each loading step in a single progress card (#27) (`b5e850b`)
- Make the go-to-code editor configurable and report failures in the status bar (#26) (`b08f7d7`)
- Unsubscribe the main window from previous preview sessions (#25) (`2aedf60`)
- Add AGENTS.md with the project rules and techniques (#24) (`9767921`)
- Document supported platforms in the README (#17) (`6d4a9ed`)
- Ship only desktop platform native assets in the tool package (#16) (`dc17318`)
- Share a single headless Avalonia session across the test assembly (#14) (`7513d68`)
- Move secondary toolbar actions into an overflow menu and let the toolbar wrap (#13) (`583884d`)
- Add accessible names to icon-only buttons in the main window (#12) (`7b92e8c`)
- Bind Ctrl+O to the open file command (#11) (`e106452`)
- Fix status bar width format so selected element width is shown (#9) (`929071c`)
- Fix inspect menu crash by integrating ReactiveUI with Avalonia and using EnhancedCommand (#8) (`df67f86`)
- Move catalog gallery layout and scrolling to native shell outside previewer (`a07222c`)
- Support preview of Gradients, Brushes, Typography specimens and StreamGeometry (`7a9dc22`)
- Move resource catalog gallery to native application shell sidebar (`4d4ba09`)
- Add automatic rich preview for Styles and ResourceDictionaries with flat and tree views (`cf93a33`)
- feat: add right-click inspect context menu with visual tree hierarchy navigation (`cf42ad2`)
- feat: resolve source XAML file for nested controls in visual inspection (`288a260`)
- feat: marcar visualmente los controles bajo el puntero con Adorner en tiempo real (`d8567b4`)
- fix: corregir orden de canales de color (RGBA vs BGRA) en el renderizado del previsualizador (`0c1b102`)
- feat: inyectar Design.DataContext, fondo de tema y DataTemplates en la previsualización (`7bf65dc`)
- fix: resolver ensamblados dependientes, behaviors y runtimeconfig al previsualizar soluciones complejas (`3cc7d5c`)
- feat: Implement custom interactive preview host with live element inspection and XAML source mapping (`7e9000e`)
- style: homogenizar altura a 30px y compactar tipografía en la barra de herramientas (`0f67a87`)
- refactor: simplificar encuadre inicial usando ZoomBorder.AutoFit en lugar de manipular la ventana (`76d90b9`)
- feat: autoajustar tamaño de ventana al contenido en carga inicial y compactar barra de herramientas (`c80c6b3`)
- fix: normalizar URIs de archivo (file://) y corregir recurso de icono Avalonia (`0e16bc2`)
- feat: Add desktop integration script for Linux and update README (`93e96b3`)
- feat: Add package icon and Flaticon attribution to README and app (`5a34c21`)
